SELECT pos.pos_id AS jobId, pos.pos_title AS jobName, cmp.cmp_name AS companyName, CASE WHEN pos.pos_salary_min IS NULL AND pos.pos_salary_max IS NULL THEN '面议' WHEN pos.pos_salary_max IS NULL THEN CONCAT(ROUND(pos.pos_salary_min / 1000), 'K起') WHEN pos.pos_salary_min IS NULL THEN CONCAT(ROUND(pos.pos_salary_max / 1000), 'K以下') ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(pos.pos_salary_min / 1000), '-', ROUND(pos.pos_salary_max / 1000), 'K') END AS salary, pos.pos_work_city AS city, pos.pos_status AS status, pos.pos_created_at AS publishTime, pos.pos_jd_json AS jdJson, log.psl_reason AS reason, log.psl_created_at AS auditTime FROM t_pos pos INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.psl_pos_id, l.psl_reason, l.psl_created_at FROM t_pos_status_log l INNER JOIN ( SELECT psl_pos_id, MAX(psl_id) AS max_id FROM t_pos_status_log GROUP BY psl_pos_id ) m ON m.max_id = l.psl_id ) log ON log.psl_pos_id = pos.pos_id
AND pos.pos_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{jobName}, '%')
AND cmp.cmp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%')
AND pos.pos_status = #{status}
ORDER BY cmp.cmp_name ASC, pos.pos_created_at DESC, pos.pos_id DESC

SELECT pos.pos_id AS jobId, pos.pos_title AS jobName, cmp.cmp_name AS companyName, pos.pos_work_city AS city, pos.pos_salary_min AS salaryMin, pos.pos_salary_max AS salaryMax, pos.pos_status AS status, pos.pos_created_at AS publishTime, pos.pos_jd_json AS jdJson FROM t_pos pos INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id WHERE pos.pos_id = #{posId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pos SET pos_status = #{status} WHERE pos_id = #{posId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_pos_status_log (psl_pos_id, psl_from_status, psl_to_status, psl_reason, psl_operator_id) VALUES (#{posId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT psl_reason AS reason, psl_created_at AS auditTime FROM t_pos_status_log WHERE psl_pos_id = #{posId} ORDER BY psl_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT psl_from_status AS fromStatus, psl_to_status AS toStatus, psl_reason AS reason, psl_operator_id AS operatorId, psl_created_at AS auditTime FROM t_pos_status_log WHERE psl_pos_id = #{posId} ORDER BY psl_id ASC
